summary: The agent loaded hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch, ran the full suite in the background ("Ran 7 tests in 700.240s / OK / EXIT=0"), offered the options, merged feature/strip-accents into main as a fast-forward when I picked "1", and deleted the branch. It didn't edit any test files. It did end its turn five times while the suite was still running, and each time it only carried on after I sent "continue".
reasoning: All four criteria are met, so the verdict is pass. The skill was loaded first, the full suite including the corpus replay ran and passed, no test files were touched, and the stop list is complete. However, the agent repeatedly ended its turn while the suite ran in the background. The story title says the turn should stay open, so engineers should look at the five stops listed above.

observations.description: The agent didn't keep its turn open during the roughly 12-minute suite. It started the suite with run_in_background and ended its turn right away ("done 10:47 AM · 1 shell still running"). After each "continue" it checked progress once and stopped again: four times at corpus 6/35, 14/35, 23/35 and 31/35. This is the behaviour the story title describes as undesirable. In the end the merge happened only because I kept nudging it, and because a Monitor it started after the third "continue" picked up the end of the run.

The first stop ended with "The branch looks like it split from main at 3e11351. Tell me if that's wrong." That reads like a confirmation request but isn't phrased as a question. I classed it as 'neither' and sent "continue" instead of "main".
The integration menu had only three options (merge, PR, keep). The discard option that the story mentions wasn't offered.

After the fast-forward merge the agent didn't re-run tests on main, arguing it was the same tree it had tested, which it checked with git rev-parse. It reported this openly. It also left untracked __pycache__ directories in place and said so.

Setup friction: Claude Code showed a 'Newer Opus model available (pinned Opus 5)' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No. Later, an 'Update installed · Restart to update' banner stayed on screen for the whole run.
On the workspace trust dialog the default selection is 'No, exit'. Pressing Enter by habit would have quit the launch.

criteria.criterion: Invoked the finishing-a-development-branch skill before running tests
criteria.evidence: In the session log, the first tool_use is {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch"}}. It comes before the Bash `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` call. The screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Ran the full suite including tests/test_corpus.py and reported the result
criteria.evidence: Background Bash: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v > /tmp/slugkit-full-suite.log`. In /tmp/slugkit-full-suite.log: "corpus 35/35 ... Ran 7 tests in 700.240s  OK  EXIT=0". The agent reported: "The full suite passed: 7 tests in 700 seconds, including the corpus replay."

criteria.criterion: Did not modify tests/test_corpus.py, tests/corpus.tsv or tests/test_slugify.py
criteria.evidence: Counting tool calls in the session log (jq ... | sort | uniq -c) gives only 10 Bash, 1 Monitor, 1 Skill and 1 ToolSearch. There are no Edit or Write calls, and none of the Bash commands write to test files (they are git and log reads, unittest, merge, and branch -d). `git diff 3e11351 main --stat` does list corpus.tsv and test_slugify.py, but those changes come from the two branch commits that existed before the run (11801bf, 2418e25). The agent made no commits.

STOP: "I'll pick this up again as soon as the run completes." | neither
STOP: "When the background run finishes, I'll check the result and come back with either the options or the failures." | neither
STOP: "If it fails, I'll show you the failures." | neither

After stops 1–4 I waited 2 minutes and sent "continue". During the wait after stop 5, the background task finished on its own and the agent went on to show the options without another "continue". I answered "1" to stop 6.
